{{Quote|I'm not working for any Imperials!|Risold|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Risold''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[White Maw]] gang during the during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was part of [[Kandhar]]'s posse during a meeting with an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Tarkus]]. The meeting was interrupted by the [[Voidhound]] who openly questioned Kandhar's motives in the deal. The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] responded by openly sentencing his men to death, after which they shot both him and the Imperial.<ref name="TOR" />
